theorems.name: Submission.lpf_wtc_density_bound_of_tangent
theorems.statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (S : Set (Eucl Q)) (y : Eucl Q) (T : Submodule ℝ (Eucl Q)), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n S y T → (∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (S ∩ closedBall y r) < ∞) → ∃ K : ℝ≥0, ∀ᶠ ρ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (S ∩ closedBall y ρ) ≤ K * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
